newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Elektra started at buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Elektra started at buy.

text.p: ING Barings on Wednesday saod it initiated coverage of Mexico's Grupo Elektra SA with a buy recommendation.
The rating on the retailer's stock was based on a year-end target price of $20.32 per American Depositary Receipt and expectations of vigorous sales growth, the firm said in a research report.
The ADRs were up 1/2 at 18-1/2 early Wednesday afternoon.
In the report, analyst Sebastian Barry-Taylor said he expected the retailer to show 30.7 percent sales growth in 1997 and a 12.2 percent increase in operating profit.

"The company is leveraging its distribution network towards high-margin financial services, such as basic banking, and enjoys an enviable position with the all-important low-income population segment," Barry-Taylor wrote.
